text_block_list.text:
Mayano! Mayano!
Mayano! Mayano!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: ...I won.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I did it. I won against Brian.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: T-Trainer! I... I...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Yeah...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I was incredible, wasn't I? I was totally twinkly, right?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! Traaaaainer!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... I'm still out of breath...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I lost. I pulled out all the stops... and was

defeated. But... I don't hate this feeling.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Hmph, this is...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Brian!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: ...Are you really okay with this?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: ...Ah, right. It's not over yet.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...I still have my final announcement.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
You are as rigid as a mountain... I
suppose I can't
change your mind.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
...The press is already waiting. You might
as well
make your ceremony as brilliant
as possible.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
All right, Brian. We're scheduled to start
in five
minutes.
text_block_list.name: Staff

text_block_list.text: Right... Got it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I finished running on turf. Not
the turf at
the academy, but the turf
here.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
No way! Brian! Show us more of your
majesty!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text: Please don't quit!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Enough whining. You can take
your
dreams...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: And shove them onto Маяно Топ Ган.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: —Okay! A-and now, Нарита Брайан's final—
text_block_list.name: Host

text_block_list.text: Stooooop!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
No way can I just sit back and watch this
happen!
You're not allowed to quit,
Brian!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Huh?! B-but...
text_block_list.name: Host

text_block_list.text:
No buts! I don't want her to quit, so she
can't!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: ...Hey.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
You think you can simply show up out of
nowhere
and talk whatever garbage you
want? You
already won.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Think about what that means! Spare me
your
childish antics.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: But I am a child!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
A child who's gonna become a grown-up
racer
who faces off against you a lot,
Brian!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
That's why I can say whatever I want!
Even if it's
selfish—because I'm a kid!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I wanna keep running with you, Brian!
Promise
you'll race against me again!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Wh-what?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
What's wrong with you? Please, today
is—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: You're not quitting!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Hey!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Pfft... Ahaha!
text_block_list.name: Fan C

text_block_list.text:
That's right! Don't quit, Brian! Face off
against
the champion!
text_block_list.name: Spectator D

text_block_list.text:
It's not like you to turn down a challenge
like
that, Brian!
text_block_list.name: Spectator E

text_block_list.text: Who asked you to chime in?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Haha! Everyone knows you well, Brian!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
But I know you even better. I mean, even
now...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I can tell that you wanna run with me
again—that
you wanna get even more
excited!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! That's why I'm gonna stick with
you!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
The more I race against someone who
twinkles
like you, the more twinkly of a
grown-up I can
become!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: ...What a load of crap.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
You're demanding I keep racing out of
pure
selfishness.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: That's right!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
...Damn it. You're nothing but a hopeless
child.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but I'll be a grown-up in no
time! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: That's not what I was getting at...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Hehe... Accept your defeat, Нарита Брайан.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: No one here wants you to quit.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Not even you.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You still have time to change your mind.
Make
this ceremony into one of a
different kind.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Oooh, good idea! We'll make it my
challenge
ceremony!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
What?! As if I would hand over the
spotlight—
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: C'mon, it's no big deal! Right, President?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hm, I find no issue with that. I'm sure the
press
will also enjoy this exciting turn of
events.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Copy that! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: ...What a child you are.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! ☆ You must be dying to see me
all
grown-up. You can hardly even wait,
right?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I hate to admit it, but I'm looking
forward to it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
